basis: Accepted submission row 35, exp-148 R2b-w100-kno; exported predictions match the accepted file.

level2.selection_rounds: Mean of best rounds from leave-one-training-month-out CV
level2.forms: Mean of raw LightGBM and CatBoost residuals plus the anchor, then floor at 60 seconds

local_selection.reason: Local v32 references inherit held-label paths; noac and ordinary without AOBT keeps account for about 206 of the gain.

validation: Month-hold level 2; excludes labels of the scored month and buffer days, with jjx member fits excluding January, July and their own month.
reproduction_limits: All R2 member artifacts, feature caches, fitted model files and derived input packages must be rebuilt; they are not redistributed.
The frozen class rows and their cell inventory must be regenerated from the same raw and open-source versions.
New CV rounds, cache vocabularies, CPU/GPU libraries and thread counts can change fresh-fit values.
The v32 fallback retains the 16 old fitting faults in its public record.
No fresh fit has reproduced the accepted v35 vector.
